title: Viper Strike
description: Start the engines, taxi, and take off in a 3D fighter jet, then dogfight enemy fighters, dodge SAMs, and wreck the enemy airfield before your fuel runs out. New pilots can start with Flight training, where a coach shows exactly which key to press.
controls: New to flying? Pick Flight training: ten lessons with a live coach that shows which key to press right now, no enemies and no fuel limit
W and S (or the up and down arrows) pitch the nose. S pulls the nose up
A and D (or the left and right arrows) roll. Z and C work the rudder and steer on the ground
Shift and Ctrl set the throttle (also + and -, or Page Up and Page Down). Full throttle lights the afterburner
G raises and lowers the gear, F the flaps, and holding B brakes
Space fires the gun. Q, E or a click fires a missile, best once the lock tone is steady
R picks the next target, X drops flares, V swaps between chase and cockpit views
P or Esc pauses, with stick sensitivity and volume settings. M mutes
Land at home base and stop to rearm and refuel
